args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The file src/export/csv.ts is responsible for CSV exports. It shows that a byte order mark (BOM) is deliberately prefixed to CSV by default (bom option defaults to true), which explains why the first column appears as \ufeffDate. This code directly relates to the issue and explains the behavior.
